claims: Alycia Baumgardner is the unified super featherweight champion.
Alycia Baumgardner defends her WBA, WBO, and IBF titles against Bo Mi Re Shin.
The Alycia Baumgardner vs. Bo Mi Re Shin bout is at the Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden.
The Alycia Baumgardner vs. Bo Mi Re Shin bout is on Friday, April 17, 2026.
The Alycia Baumgardner vs. Bo Mi Re Shin bout highlights the MVPW-02 card.
Alycia Baumgardner had a 2025 victory over Leila Beaudoin.
